description: Current page as a compact tree; interactive elements carry ref=eN for click/type/select; draggable ones are marked (drag: from ref to ref). Refs stay valid while the element exists. mode=diff shows only changes.

cursor.description: line to continue from when the tree was truncated

mode.description: full (default) or only what changed since the last snapshot

scope.description: ref of a section to show only that subtree

name: snapshot
title: snapshot
